title: three identical dir-scan loops with break-on-error should be a shared helper
description: cleanup_tmp_files, cleanup_orphan_msg_files, and the dead/ count loop in drain_once all implement the same read_dir + loop { match next_entry() } pattern with identical error handling. The break-on-entry-error bug exists in all three. A private async fn scan_dir_entries(dir: &Path) -> Vec<DirEntry> (or an iterator) that centralises the read_dir loop would: (1) fix the break-vs-continue bug once, (2) remove three copies of the same error arm. Suggested rewrite: async fn collect_dir_entries(dir: &Path) -> Vec<tokio::fs::DirEntry> that logs and continues on per-entry errors and logs and returns empty vec on open error.
